sentences.en: Ronnie's music and legacy live in all of us!
sentences.zh: 罗尼的音乐和他的遗产永远活在我们心中!

sentences.en: The previous government had bequeathed a legacy of problems.
sentences.zh: 上一届政府遗留下来了许多问题。

sentences.en: This isn't about money or power. This is about my legacy.
sentences.zh: 这不关乎金钱或权力。这是关于我的遗产。

senses.zh: 遗产，遗赠物；遗留问题，后遗症
